representativeOrder.scenario: Premium Unlimited × 5, FLAT10 promo, User A via Login → SIGN UP → OR LOGIN detour
representativeOrder.notes: The live discovery run inadvertently added 5 × Standard (not Premium Unlimited): with 4 visible #add buttons on the logged-in tickets view, idx=3 resolved to Standard, not Premium Unlimited. The runbook's 'Bubble shared IDs: #add and #add-item' entry documents `0=Standard, 1=Premium, 2=Standard Unlimited, 3=Premium Unlimited` for the GUEST landing; the LOGGED-IN user view for this specific User A + event rendered a different DOM order (likely reshuffled by prior-purchase data), producing Standard at idx=3. The Order Confirmed screen showed `5 x Standard $250.00 Subtotal, -$10.00 Discount, +$10.00 SF, +$16.25 Tax = $266.25 Total`. All SELECTORS captured here are still valid for the register-to-login flow — the ticket-index issue is a separate shared-ID disambiguation problem noted in newGotchas.

steps.businessName: click Tickets button on landing view
steps.notes: Unique id. Click via el.click(). URL becomes ?tab=tickets. Anchor wait: `location.search.includes('tab=tickets')`. Registry: ### Login flow: 'Login' link only appears inside the tickets view.

steps.businessName: click top-right Login link in tickets view
steps.notes: Unique id. Triggers login popup. Wait anchor: heading h2 with text 'Log in' visible. Registry: ### UI transitions: wait for specific visible elements.

steps.businessName: fill Email in the Login popup (no id — target by popup + type=email)
steps.notes: Email input in Log-In popup has NO id. Unique class `cnxpg1`. Select via: `Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type=email]')).filter(e => e.offsetParent !== null)[0]`. Use native setter + input+change events (Registry: ### Bubble input: `el.value = x` does not register). The popup's Log-In form is one of THREE states this container hosts (Log-In / Sign-Up / Sign-Up after OR LOGIN flip-back); each has a unique CSS-hash class, so disambiguate by popup state heading before filling.

steps.businessName: fill Password in the Login popup (no id — target by popup + type=password)
steps.notes: Password input in Log-In popup has NO id. Unique class `cnxph1`. Select via: `Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type=password]')).filter(e => e.offsetParent !== null)[0]`. Native setter + input+change events. Registry: ### Bubble input.

steps.businessName: click SIGN UP inside the Log-In popup (flips to Sign-Up form)
steps.notes: SIGN UP button inside the Log-In popup has NO id. Unique class `cnxpo1`. Text-based selector: `Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.offsetParent !== null && b.textContent.trim() === 'SIGN UP' && /cnxpo1/.test(b.className))`. DO NOT confuse with the SIGN UP button INSIDE the Sign-Up form (different class `cnxpaV1`). Wait anchor after click: heading h2 with text 'Create an 8Count profile' visible.

steps.businessName: click OR LOGIN on the Sign-Up form (flips popup BACK to Log-In form) — DEFINING ELEMENT of this flow
steps.notes: *** DEFINING ELEMENT of the register-to-login flow *** NO id. Unique class `cnxpa1` (distinct from every other button in the app). Exact text 'OR LOGIN' (uppercase, single word pair). It is a <button>, NOT a text link — runbook 'Login & Signup' section is explicit on this. Selector: `Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.offsetParent !== null && b.textContent.trim() === 'OR LOGIN')`. Alternate class-based: `document.querySelector('button.cnxpa1:not([style*=display:none])')` — prefer the text+visibility filter because Bubble's CSS hashes may change across republishes. After click, popup flips back to Log-In form (heading h2 = 'Log in'), Email and Password fields are BLANK again. Ask user to add an ID Attribute in the Bubble editor — this is the single most flow-critical selector with no id.

steps.businessName: fill Email in the popup Log-In form (post-flip, fields are empty)
steps.notes: Same element as step 3 — the Log-In form shares unique class `cnxpg1` across the two times it becomes visible. After OR LOGIN flip, email is blank again (verified). Use native setter + input+change events.

steps.businessName: fill Password in the popup Log-In form (post-flip)
steps.notes: Same element as step 4. Native setter + input+change events.

steps.businessName: click LOG IN in the popup
steps.notes: LOG IN button has NO id. Unique class `cnxpi1`. Selector: `Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.offsetParent !== null && b.textContent.trim() === 'LOG IN' && /cnxpi1/.test(b.className))`. Post-login state signal: `document.getElementById('gp-test-login-link').offsetParent === null` (Login link hidden) AND popup heading 'Log in' no longer visible. Logout appears inside #button-back-to-event-page on mouse-over. No avatar element on this event page.

steps.businessName: click ADD on the Premium Unlimited ticket card (index 3 of 4 visible #add buttons)
steps.notes: Shared id `add` — filter visible (`offsetParent !== null`), pick by DOM index. Registry: ### Bubble shared IDs: `#add` and `#add-item`. CANONICAL guest-order DOM index: 0=Standard, 1=Premium, 2=Std Unlimited, 3=Prem Unlimited. CAUTION: In this live discovery run (User A, logged-in), idx 3 resolved to Standard, not Prem Unlimited (see newGotchas). Verify the card name textContent from the DOM parent of the #add element before clicking if DOM order is uncertain.

steps.businessName: click #add-item + 4 times on the Prem Unlimited card to reach qty 5
steps.notes: After ADD click, the card transitions to quantity widget. Only one #add-item visible initially (only Prem Unlimited activated). Click idx 0 four times. Wait anchor: `document.querySelectorAll('#add-item')[0].offsetParent !== null` before each click. Registry: ### Bubble shared IDs.

steps.businessName: click ENTER PROMO CODE button at bottom of tickets view
steps.notes: Unique id. Reveals the promo input + submit button. Wait anchor after click: `document.getElementById('input-enter-promo')` visible.

steps.businessName: fill promo input with FLAT10
steps.notes: Native setter + input+change events. Registry: ### Bubble input.

steps.businessName: click SUBMIT to apply the promo
steps.notes: Wait anchor: body contains 'FLAT10' (applied promo badge) and a '-$' discount line. Cart subtotal should decrease by $10.

steps.businessName: click PROCEED TO CHECKOUT
steps.class: clickable-element bubble-element Group cnpqaZ0 bubble-r-container relative
steps.notes: Unique id. Wait anchor after click: `document.getElementById('main-full-name')` visible (Step 1 loaded). Registry: ### Bubble checkout: PROCEED TO CHECKOUT containing div may intercept pointer events — if el.click() no-ops, click the inner text ref.

steps.businessName: probe Step 1 auto-fill (logged-in branch)
steps.notes: Observed: Step 1 IS auto-pre-filled for the logged-in user. main-full-name = 'GP E2E Order 06' (prior order's name), main-email = 'abhjoseph+usera@gmail.com' (User A). NO further fill is required for logged-in flow — overwrite only if the scenario demands a different ticket-holder name. Registry: ### Bubble input (if overwriting).

steps.businessName: check 'contact info is same for all tickets' checkbox
steps.class: clickable-element bubble-element Group coaWaPs1 bubble-r-container flex row
steps.text: checkThe contact information is the same for all tickets
steps.notes: Checked state signal: inline `style.background` is `none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14)`. Unchecked: `none rgb(255, 255, 255)`. Poll the background-alpha to verify the click registered before advancing.

steps.businessName: check 'I am the authorized cardholder' consent checkbox at bottom of Step 1
steps.class: clickable-element bubble-element Group cpmaJo1 bubble-r-container flex row
steps.text: checkI am the authorized cardholder for this purchase...
steps.notes: NO id (Registry: ### Bubble Step-1: 'authorized cardholder' checkbox has no ID). Selector: `Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.clickable-element.bubble-element.Group')).find(e => e.offsetParent !== null && /authorized cardholder/i.test(e.textContent))`. IMPORTANT: on the first discovery run the click missed (bg stayed rgb(255,255,255)) — always verify `style.background` contains `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14)` after clicking and re-click if it didn't register. This is the most flaky step after the OR LOGIN click.

steps.businessName: click CONTINUE on Step 1 (logged-in variant — NOT 'CONTINUE AS GUEST')
steps.notes: Unique id. For logged-in users, the exit button is `#continue-registered-user` (text: CONTINUE), NOT `#continue-as-guest` (which is a guest-only button). If both checkboxes above are not in the checked state (bg alpha 0.14), this button silently no-ops. Wait anchor after click: `document.getElementById('toggle-terms')` visible AND `document.getElementById('complete-order-authnet')` OR '+ Add Payment Method' text visible.

steps.businessName: probe Step 2 payment options — saved card vs Add Payment Method
steps.notes: Observed: User A has a saved payment method from prior orders, so PAY NOW button `#complete-order-authnet` is present — NO Add-Payment-Method detour needed. If a fresh User A run (no prior orders) is required, look for '+ Add Payment Method' text (Registry: ### Authorize.net: 'Add Payment Method' detour for first-order-per-logged-in-user) and branch accordingly. No #complete-order-authnet-0 element → not a $0 order.

steps.businessName: toggle the Terms & Conditions ionic toggle
steps.notes: Registry: ### Bubble ionic-toggle: outer div click silently no-ops — click inner <label>. Selector: `document.getElementById('toggle-terms').querySelector('label').click()`. Verify: `document.querySelector('#toggle-terms input[type=checkbox]').checked === true`.

steps.businessName: click PAY NOW (saved-card path — no Authorize.net redirect needed)
steps.notes: With a saved card, PAY NOW completes the order IN-PAGE (no redirect to test.authorize.net). The confirmation view renders at the same URL with body text 'Order Confirmed' + 'Order #<HUMAN>'. Wait anchor: `location.search.includes('success=yes') || /Order Confirmed|Purchase Completed/.test(document.body.innerText)` (Registry: ### Authorize.net: post-return success heading is too brief — key on the URL query, although in this saved-card branch the body text persists long enough). Add-Payment-Method branch WOULD redirect — see Registry: ### Authorize.net: 'Add Payment Method' detour for first-order-per-logged-in-user.

steps.businessName: assert Order Confirmed + capture human order number
steps.notes: Body contains: 'Order Confirmed\nOrder #<HUMAN>\n...'. Captured order #FDUZF-4049 in this run. Registry: ### Bubble async backend: tax/custom-fee workflow runs AFTER the success URL flag — wait 30s before reconciling via Bubble API.

newGotchas.symptom: The entire Log-In popup (Email, Password, LOG IN, SIGN UP, and — on the Sign-Up side — OR LOGIN) has NO id attributes. The popup is rendered by a `div.bubble-element.CustomElement.cnxtc1` with no id.
newGotchas.cause: The Bubble editor does not assign IDs to the Custom Element's inner widgets.
newGotchas.fix: Ask the user to add `ID Attribute` values in the Bubble editor for at least: Log-In email, Log-In password, LOG IN button, SIGN UP button (inside Log-In), OR LOGIN button (inside Sign-Up), Sign-Up email, Sign-Up password, Sign-Up confirm-password, SIGN UP button (inside Sign-Up). Until then, select by unique Bubble CSS hash class (e.g. `cnxpg1` Log-In email, `cnxph1` Log-In password, `cnxpi1` LOG IN, `cnxpo1` SIGN UP-from-login, `cnxpa1` OR LOGIN, `cnxpaP1` Sign-Up email, `cnxpaQ1` Sign-Up password, `cnxpaU1` Sign-Up confirm, `cnxpaV1` SIGN UP-on-signup-form) combined with text content + `offsetParent !== null`. These hash classes are regenerated on republish, so the safer selector is `button/textContent === 'OR LOGIN' && offsetParent !== null`.

newGotchas.component: Bubble shared IDs — logged-in user view reshuffles #add DOM order
newGotchas.symptom: Runbook Registry entry 'Bubble shared IDs: `#add` and `#add-item` disambiguated by visibility + DOM order' says initial #add visible order is `0=Standard, 1=Premium, 2=Std Unlimited, 3=Prem Unlimited`. For a logged-in User A on this event, clicking visible #add idx 3 added STANDARD (5 × $50 = $250), not Prem Unlimited. The Order Confirmed screen showed `5 x Standard`.
newGotchas.cause: Unknown — possibly the logged-in view reorders cards by prior-purchase affinity, or the Premium/Unlimited cards are filtered-by-attribute for the logged-in user, or the initial `offsetParent !== null` filter is being distorted by a different layout path. Needs investigation.
newGotchas.fix: DO NOT rely on static DOM-order indices on the logged-in tickets view. Before clicking #add, enumerate the 4 cards and match by their VISIBLE TITLE text. Proposed selector: walk up from each visible `button#add` to the nearest ancestor with `role=region`/group heading, read its title text (`'Standard' | 'Premium' | 'Standard Unlimited' | 'Premium Unlimited'`), and pick the matching card. Add a Registry entry on promotion.
newGotchas.source: Discovery run for register-to-login-checkout flow, 2026-04-23. Representative order #18 wanted Prem Unlimited × 5 but the run produced Standard × 5; the miscount did not block discovery of the OR LOGIN selector (the defining element of this flow), but the ticket-selection primitive needs the ancestor-title strategy before Phase 2.

newGotchas.symptom: First click on the authorized-cardholder group DIV silently failed — `style.background` stayed `rgb(255, 255, 255)` (unchecked) after the click. Second click on the same element checked it (`rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14)`). CONTINUE only advances once both checkboxes register as checked.
newGotchas.cause: Unknown — possibly a race between a re-render triggered by the 'contact-info-same' click immediately before it, and the 'authorized' element's onclick handler. `document.querySelectorAll('.clickable-element.bubble-element.Group')` returns a live-ish list; a re-render between `find()` and `.click()` can send the click to a stale reference.
newGotchas.fix: After the 'contact-info-same' click, wait for the next tick (at least one `await page.waitForTimeout(400)` or better: poll until `#contact-info-same`'s bg is 0.14), THEN re-query the authorized-cardholder element inside the click. Verify bg is 0.14 after the click; if not, click again (up to 3 retries).

newGotchas.component: Bubble Step-1 exit button — logged-in variant
newGotchas.symptom: Runbook references `#continue-as-guest` as the Step-1 exit button for the guest flow. For a logged-in user (here User A), `#continue-as-guest` does not exist; the exit button is `#continue-registered-user` (text: 'CONTINUE').
newGotchas.cause: Bubble renders different exit buttons based on the user's auth state: `#continue-as-guest` for guests, `#continue-registered-user` for logged-in users. (The guest→register flow introduces a third: 'REGISTER & SAVE INFO'.)
newGotchas.fix: The fragmentStep1Contact 'loggedIn mode' primitive should key on `#continue-registered-user`, not `#continue-as-guest`. Probe which id exists, then click whichever is visible. Promote this as a Registry entry once `logged-in-checkout` discovery confirms the same id.
newGotchas.source: Discovery run for register-to-login-checkout flow, 2026-04-23. This is a UNIQUE finding of this flow's discovery (same as `logged-in-checkout` will be, since register-to-login terminates in the same logged-in state as logged-in-checkout).
